marked_frame.labels:
Labels drawn on the picture:
[ME] = you
[R1] = something good to get (down, a bit away)
[R2] = something good to get (down-right, a bit away)
[R3] = something good to get (down, far)
[R4] = something good to get (right, far)
[R5] = something good to get (down-right, far)
[D1] = a way through (down-right, far)

honesty: Our own simple 2D game; the truth comes from the game itself. Not evidence of accuracy on other games.
